outputs.format: First line schema extended_profile_cpu_rows_v1: declared scope meanings plus installed labels. Subsequent lines contain public label, call/parent ID, thread ID/name, perf_counter start/end/host wall, raised boolean and profiler step hints.
outputs.privacy: No args, kwargs, input/output references, image/token/tensor values, RNG bytes, private environment or exception messages serialized. CPU sidecar is created exclusively with mode0600 and existing output is not overwritten.
outputs.scope: All original wrapped calls after native TrainingStageTiming.__init__, including CPU workers and calls outside Kineto active3. Finally restores all added instance/class/module patches before writing rows.

targets.sample_queries_inclusive: framework module global sample_queries (actual imported callsite)
targets.prepared_current_transfer_optimizer_batc: prepared_current module transfer_optimizer_batch, before trainer's later from-import

implementation_bounds: Only process-local instrumentation; each wrapper calls the original once with identical positional/keyword arguments and returns the same object. Native exceptions propagate without storing their messages.

No added CUDA event, synchronization, collective, device transfer, tensor inspection or sampling. CPU workers only run record_function and host clocks/counters; original CUDA/NCCL/sync operators remain visible through Kineto.

The timer being CPU-only does not force get_rope_index or any other original computation onto CPU. IO get_rope_index can operate on original device inputs; prepared_current worker inputs stay CPU under the existing contract.
New labels are record_function CPU scopes with native GPU launch correlation, not additions to TrainingStageTiming CUDA event buckets. stage_timing.py is unchanged.
Current encode includes build/vision/language; build includes processor/RoPE/vision in the ordinary path. Nested host wall ranges and overlapping GPU streams/ranks must not be summed.

CPU row step hints can span prefetch windows and are not scene/update identities. Worker record_function events may be absent from Kineto; separate rows preserve actual host wall measurements without inventing GPU events.

Only engineering_fast uses transfer_optimizer_batch and ExecutionLogWindow.flush. IO mode has inline metric logging; zero calls for those two labels are expected there. Inline IO logging remains native Kineto operators rather than a fabricated flush call/range.

Existing profile.step remains inside engine.step: final active optimizer/update timing can include export overhead. Use actual markers/flows and per-stream interval unions; this profile is not the registered main throughput benchmark.
CPU rows in memory are scoped to the bounded profile process. Sidecar presence alone is not a completion/numerical/acceptance receipt; use actual existing process/training completion artifacts.
